scope: OpenTUI Bash mode in the chat composer
implementation: production OpenTUI frontend built from src/terminal/opentui/
input: isolated PTY at 80x24; ! and the command characters were sent one at a time, Return and Backspace as their own keys
fixture: copied isolated verifier state and data; the controlled loopback provider was running for model catalog calls

rule.enter: typing ! at the start of an empty prompt, with an optional pasted body
rule.marker: the chevron becomes ! and is hidden from the draft
rule.body: the command and its marker use theme.bashMode
rule.exit: Backspace on an empty Bash command restores the chevron and neutral rules
rule.submit: the command reaches the normal Bash gate as !command

captures.kind: actual PTY cumulative raw ANSI stream
captures.note: Bash mode entered with ! and no command yet

captures.kind: actual PTY cumulative raw ANSI stream
captures.note: Backspace on the empty Bash command returns to the prompt

captures.kind: actual PTY cumulative raw ANSI stream
captures.note: A Bash command submitted through the normal gate; approval shown

limits: The fixture state is disposable and carries no user credentials.
The capture stops at the approval gate; it does not accept or deny the command.
